# Website dependency acknowledgments and license notices

Thank you to the authors and contributors of every package below. This inventory includes build-time and transitive dependencies installed for this platform, not just browser-shipped code. Generated from installed package metadata; original notices are retained verbatim. Platform-optional dependencies not installed here are listed separately from the lockfile below.

The OpenAI Sites starter generated the project scaffold. The shadcn/ui components copied into components/ui, lib and hooks originate from shadcn and contributors (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui, MIT); see SHADCN-LICENSE.txt. OpenEars page content, styling, profile tooling and wordmark are original project contributions. System fonts are supplied by the visitor’s OS; no external font or photo assets are shipped.
